authority: Canonical deterministic recruitment-background distributions and registered selection transforms. Population ledgers own bodies; ChatGPT never authors starting capability values.

regular_army.rule: Baseline full-time professional state-army regimen. Training opportunity requires lawful facilities, equipment, command-chain instruction, fatigue capacity and elapsed time; reserve maintenance is a separate explicit regimen.

legacy_migration.migration_reason: replace temporary 112h professional tier with universal 48h/week active/enrolled clock

regular_army.schedule_rule: Universal active/enrolled professional schedule: 48 deliberate training hours per 7-day cycle. Rank, faction, prestige and canon importance change curriculum, instructor/facility quality and actual role experience, never calendar training time.

household_professional.schedule_rule: Universal active/enrolled professional schedule: 48 deliberate training hours per 7-day cycle. Rank, faction, prestige and canon importance change curriculum, instructor/facility quality and actual role experience, never calendar training time.

house_tang_max_sustainable.rule: House Tang and Sword Manor use the same 48-hour weekly professional training clock as other active institutions. Their advantage comes from registered curriculum, instructor quality, facilities, equipment, recovery and command-chain delivery, never extra calendar hours.
house_tang_max_sustainable.schedule_rule: Universal active/enrolled professional schedule: 48 deliberate training hours per 7-day cycle. Rank, faction, prestige and canon importance change curriculum, instructor/facility quality and actual role experience, never calendar training time.

civilian_skilled.rule: Civilian or independent skill development requires verified practice opportunity; time passage alone grants nothing.

professional_officer.rule: Full-time professional officers use the same 48-hour weekly deliberate-training clock as troops. Their curriculum emphasizes command, staff work and relevant arms; actual command experience is settled separately from the training clock.

elite_command.rule: Elite field commanders use the same 48-hour weekly deliberate-training clock as other active professionals. Exceptional development comes from aptitude, instructors, facilities, curriculum and real command/combat experience, not extra calendar hours.
elite_command.schedule_rule: Universal active/enrolled professional schedule: 48 deliberate training hours per 7-day cycle. Rank, faction, prestige and canon importance change curriculum, instructor/facility quality and actual role experience, never calendar training time.

elite_martial.rule: Elite martial professionals use the same 48-hour weekly deliberate-training clock as other active professionals. Their advantage comes from aptitude, instruction, facilities, equipment and relevant experience.
elite_martial.schedule_rule: Universal active/enrolled professional schedule: 48 deliberate training hours per 7-day cycle. Rank, faction, prestige and canon importance change curriculum, instructor/facility quality and actual role experience, never calendar training time.

intensive_martial_aspirant.rule: A highly committed martial youth can practice about three deliberate hours per day on average without being treated as a full-time institutional soldier; physical access and fatigue still gate credit.
intensive_martial_aspirant.schedule_rule: Universal active/enrolled professional schedule: 48 deliberate training hours per 7-day cycle. Rank, faction, prestige and canon importance change curriculum, instructor/facility quality and actual role experience, never calendar training time.

strategist_academy.rule: Selective strategist-academy students receive intensive study, staff exercises, tabletop work and supervised field observation through the same verified-hour development law.
strategist_academy.schedule_rule: Universal active/enrolled professional schedule: 48 deliberate training hours per 7-day cycle. Rank, faction, prestige and canon importance change curriculum, instructor/facility quality and actual role experience, never calendar training time.

reserve_maintenance.rule: Reserve, militia, or low-tempo formations maintaining competence around other primary duties. This is not the default full-time professional-army regimen.

martial_aspirant.rule: High-effort youth/aspirant martial development. It is below a full elite professional regimen and grants only through the saved registered program and actual physical access.

strategic_apprentice.rule: Intensive strategist/student development through study, staff exercises, logistics, reconnaissance and bounded command practice; future office or battlefield authority is never pre-granted.

statecraft_intensive.rule: Intensive ruler/statecraft education plus real court-role exposure. Role exposure affects only causally relevant registered domains.

elite_professional.rule: Exceptional full-time professionals use the same 48-hour weekly deliberate-training clock as other active professionals. Capability differences come from aptitude, curriculum, instruction, facilities, equipment and actual experience.
elite_professional.schedule_rule: Universal active/enrolled professional schedule: 48 deliberate training hours per 7-day cycle. Rank, faction, prestige and canon importance change curriculum, instructor/facility quality and actual role experience, never calendar training time.

rules.unknown_background_policy: reject_explicit_unknown; population defaults may resolve only from registered population_background_defaults
rules.sampling: deterministic truncated normal within explicit per-metric bounds
rules.materialization: materialized people inherit one deterministic point from their saved cohort distribution and never create headcount
rules.candidate_campaign_principle: Applicants are reserved real population bodies; tests condition distributions but grant no training; rejected bodies return to their original strata.
rules.unlisted_skill_semantics: A skill absent from a background profile is canonically untrained at 0; combat weight denominators still include it and materialized people receive explicit zero fields.

activity_training_standards.law: One global active/enrolled professional training clock: 48 deliberate hours per 7 days (205.714286 per 30 days). Reserve/civilian/child exceptions are explicit. Rank, faction, prestige and canon importance change curriculum and training quality, never available training time.
activity_training_standards.time_equality_rule: All active professional military personnel and explicitly enrolled martial/command/statecraft students use the same deliberate-training clock. Specialized regimens may differ in curriculum, facilities, equipment, feedback and recovery only.
